dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: I'm Mikawa Akane, manager of the Royal Hot Springs. I'm in charge of serving and arranging accommodations for the lords from the Shogunate who are here for the hot springs.

dialogues.speaker: Mikawa Akane
dialogues.text: Traveler, you must have just arrived in Inazuma. I can tell you stories about the Inazuma hot springs, if you'd like.
